answer: Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. What survives to the gale is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, diluted when peers disagree, no identity may audit its own recruit. The ledge lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the vine is where a second reviewer recomputes them.
